states.newly_created: Fresh fabrication: crisp tool/brush marks, clean joins, minimal dirt or oxidation unless process-native.
states.in_period: Used within its historical life: modest handling wear, soot/polish/abrasion appropriate to function; no archaeological damage by default.
states.aged: Long-term aging with restrained discoloration, surface wear, patina or abrasion appropriate to material and environment.
states.damaged: Visible losses, cracks, dents, chips or abrasion; damage follows material fracture behavior rather than random grunge.
states.excavated: Earth/mineral accretions and context-specific burial effects may remain; avoid generic mud coating every surface.
states.partially_restored: Original and repaired zones remain visibly distinguishable but coherent; avoid perfect invisible restoration unless specified.
states.museum_conserved: Stabilized, cleaned and supported with restrained conservation evidence; displayed with museum-appropriate mounts/light if in scene.
states.modern_reconstruction: Newly fabricated scholarly reconstruction using modern conservation/display assumptions; do not fake archaeological age.
states.replica: Modern reproduction of an older form; material and manufacturing may be clean/new unless the user requests artificial aging.
states.fantasy_artifact: Physical artifact logic remains coherent even when iconography/material is fantastical.
